notes: Access: direct requests.get() 403'd (Access Denied / WAF); site fully accessible via curl_cffi Chrome impersonation (chrome124 profile worked for robots.txt, sitemaps, and every category page fetched). robots.txt has no ClaudeBot/Claude-User/anthropic-ai specific disallow (only a generic legacy bad-bot user-agent list, e.g. Wget/Nutch/Teleport, that does not name Claude), so extraction proceeded normally. Category tree source: Pepperfry's global header mega-menu only exposes coarse top-level links (Home Decor, Lighting, Kitchen & Dining, Mirrors, Clocks, etc. each with type=hamburger-clp/hover-X and no expandable sub-menu for these verticals, unlike Furniture which has a full hover tree) - so the real subcategory list was built from Pepperfry's own sitemap index (sitemap/home_decor.xml, lamps_and_lighting.xml, kitchen_and_dining.xml), which enumerates one sitemap file per real category slug. Each candidate slug was fetched as /category/<slug>.html and cross-checked live; only slugs that resolved to a real, distinct, populated category page were kept. Qty method: every /category/<slug>.html page server-side-renders an exact header 'Showing X-Y of <N> options in <Category Name>' - this is the site's own reported total (same class of evidence as a rendered 'N items' header favoured elsewhere in this project), not a raw Shopify/Algolia facet total, so it was trusted as exact qty without further exhaustion-walking. Duplicate/aliased URLs collapsed to one row: wall-accents.html and home-garden.html/garden-and-outdoor.html render byte-identical name+count to wall-decor.html (2,754) and outdoor-decor.html (217) respectively - dropped as exact same listing under a second URL. 'Dinnerware and Serveware' (278) and 'Drinkware and Barware' (178) sitemap slugs are auto-generated SEO combo pages recombining two categories already extracted individually (Dinnerware+Serveware, Drinkware+Barware) - excluded as overlap/subset roll-ups rather than double-counted as new inventory. Rule 0 overlap disclosure (kept as distinct rows, not dropped, since counts differ substantially so they are not the exact same listing): Wall Decor (2,754), Wall Art and Paintings (5,216), Wall Art and Decor (1,147) and Wall Hangings (768) are four separately-URLed, separately-counted wall-decor categories with likely product overlap between them; Table Decor (707, mostly desk/tabletop organiser items e.g. pen stands, visiting-card stands) and Table Decor and Accents (528, vases/planters/tealights) are differently curated but overlapping tabletop-decor buckets; Kids Decor (222, wooden kids wall clocks + height charts + wall art panels) overlaps with the main Clocks category. All kept per Rule 0 since none are proven identical listings. Excluded categories found in the sitemaps and explicitly checked before dropping: Candles (645, title itself says 'Scented, Decorative, Pillar & Tea Light Candles' - mixed/fragrance-led, dropped not padded), Spiritual (1,654) / Prayer Essentials (794) / Mandir and Pooja Essential (591) - all religious idols/diyas/incense-adjacent ritual items, not core decor scope, Home Fragrance-adjacent; Screens & Dividers (547) and Wall Shelves and Cabinets (420) - furniture (room dividers / storage shelving), title-scan confirmed; Home Utility (1,385) - coat stands/shoe bags/baskets, functional storage not decor; Fridge Magnets (50) - minor novelty/gift item, not a listed decor type; Barware (211) and Table Essentials (1,140) - mixed roll-ups of bar tools/lunch bags/cutlery-adjacent items with only partial decor content, dropped rather than padded; Artificial Plants and Flowers, Wallpaper and Decals, Festive/Holiday & Gift/deal/sale/discover-* pages, Kitchen appliances/cookware/cutlery/bakeware/disposables - excluded per explicit scope rules. Pepperfry is India's largest furniture-led marketplace; furniture, mattresses, sofas, wardrobes etc. are entirely out of scope and were not extracted (only the header mega-menu was consulted to confirm no additional decor verticals were missed).
